reference.name: Flux 2
reference.note: Separate validation reference; excluded from all test-row ranks. Twelve task values are source-rounded, while relative depth is verified from all 17 saved predictions.

policies.upgraded: One consistent alternate rule per affected task: robust depth; dataset-pooled edge OIS, saliency curve, instance PQ, and normal angle. All other tasks retain the frozen readout.
policies.ceiling: Best compatible saved readout selected after seeing each test group. For depth, the best whole-group transform among nine audited variants; for other affected tasks, the better of frozen and upgraded reductions.

qualifications: The upgraded and ceiling views reuse the same saved predictions; no model was rerun.
The ceiling is test-selected and must not be reported as a held-out benchmark result.
Depth transformations fit each query to its ground truth and are diagnostic oracle calibration.
Task rows are query-weighted means of their two dataset-group readouts.
Face landmarks and human pose retain identity-free point-set scoring; no label-aware rescore is claimed.
Semantic segmentation and appearance tasks retain their frozen primary metrics.
Flux 2 is a separate P=16 validation reference and is excluded from test rankings.
